==English==

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|enm|surveyen}}, from {{der|en|fro|sourveoir}}, {{m|fro|surveer||to oversee}}, from {{m|fro|sour-}}, {{m|fro|sur-||over}} + {{m|fro|veoir}}, {{m|fro|veeir||to see}}, from {{der|en|la|videre}}. See {{m|en|sur-}} and {{m|en|vision}}. Related to {{m|en|supervision}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{sense|noun}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈsɜːveɪ/|/sɜːˈveɪ/|a=UK}}<ref>The Chambers Dictionary, 9th Ed., 2003</ref>
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-survey (noun).wav|a=Southern England}}
** {{enPR|sûrʹvā|sər-vāʹ|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈsɝˌveɪ/|/sɚˈveɪ/}}<ref>{{R:Dictionary.com}}</ref><ref>{{R:Merriam-Webster Online}}</ref>
** In both Britain and America, the variant with initial stress is now significantly more common than that with final stress.
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)veɪ|s=2}}
* {{sense|verb}}
** {{IPA|en|/səˈveɪ/|/sɜːˈveɪ/|/ˈsɜːveɪ/|a=UK}}<ref>{{R:Collins English Dictionary}}</ref><ref>{{R:Lexico}}</ref>
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-survey (verb).wav|a=Southern England}}
** {{enPR|sər-vāʹ|sûr′vā|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/sɚˈveɪ/|/ˈsɝˌveɪ/}}<ref>{{R:American Heritage Dictionary}}</ref>
* {{rhymes|en|eɪ|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{wp}}
{{en-noun}}

# The act of surveying; a general view.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1642|author={{w|John Denham (poet)|John Denham}}|title=[[s:Coopers-hill: A Poem|Cooper's Hill]]
|passage=Under his proud '''survey''' the city lies.}}
# A particular view; an examination, especially an official examination, of a particular group of items, in order to ascertain the condition, quantity, or quality.
#: {{ux|en|A '''survey''' of the stores of a ship; a '''survey''' of roads and bridges; a '''survey''' of buildings.}}
# The operation of finding the [[contour]], [[dimensions]], [[position]], or other particulars of any part of the Earth's surface.
# A measured plan and description of any portion of country.
#: {{ux|en|The owners of the adjoining plots had conflicting '''surveys'''.}}
# An examination of the opinions and/or information of a group of people.
#: {{ux|en|The local council conducted a '''survey''' of its residents to help it decide whether to go ahead with the roadside waste collection service.}}
# A [[questionnaire]] or similar instrument used for examining the opinions and/or information of a group of people.
#: {{ux|en|I just filled out that '''survey''' on roadside waste pick-up.}}
# {{lb|en|historical}} An [[auction]] at which a [[farm]] is [[let]] for a [[lease for lives]].
# {{lb|en|US}} A [[district]] for the collection of [[customs]] under a particular [[officer]].

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|act of surveying}} {{l|en|prospect}}, {{l|en|surveil}}
* {{sense|particular view}} {{l|en|review}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[inspect]], or take a view of; to [[view]] with attention, as from a high place; to [[overlook]]
#: {{ux|en|He stood on a hill, and '''surveyed''' the surrounding country.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=III|page=90|passage=Round he '''ſurveys''', and well might, where he ſtood / So high above{{...}}|year=1873}}
# To view with a scrutinizing eye; to [[examine]].
#* {{RQ:Dryden Spanish Fryar|66|{{...}}with ſuch alter'd Looks,{{nb...}} / All pale, and ſpeechleſs, he '''ſurvey'd''' me round;}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2012|author=James Lambert|title=Beyond ''Hobson-Jobson'': A new lexicography for Indian English|journal=World Englishes|page=297|url=https://benjamins.com/catalog/eww.33.3.03lam
|text=By using the same classification system for all the dictionaries '''surveyed''', it was possible to compare the lexical richness of each against the other.}}
# To examine with reference to [[condition]], [[situation]], [[value]], etc.; to examine and ascertain the state of
#: {{ux|en|It was his job to '''survey''' buildings in order to determine their value and risks.}}
# To [[determine]] the [[form]], extent, position, etc., of, as a tract of land, a coast, harbor, or the like, by means of linear and angular measurements, and the application of the principles of geometry and trigonometry
#: {{ux|en|to '''survey''' land or a coast}}
# To examine and [[ascertain]], as the [[boundaries]] and royalties of a manor, the tenure of the tenants, and the rent and value of the same.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1713|author=Giles Jacob|title=The Complete Court-keeper: Or, Land-steward's Assistant
|passage=all the Tenants Leases and Copies are '''surveyed'''}}
# To investigate the opinions, experiences, etc., of people by asking them questions; to conduct a survey; to [[administer]] a [[questionnaire]].
#: {{syn|en|circularize}}
